prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects POST requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also listing 'text/event-stream'), even though JSON response mode never sends an SSE stream. Both PRs relax the Accept-header validation in src/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.ts to allow JSON-only Accept headers. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 implements a full RFC 7231-style media-type matcher (acceptsMediaType helper) that splits on ',' and ';', strips whitespace, and honors q=0 exclusion, so it correctly rejects Accept headers that explicitly disable JSON via q=0 and correctly parses parameterized media ranges. 2046's fix uses a plain acceptHeader.includes('application/json') substring check, which has false-positive matches against unrelated media types containing that substring (e.g. 'application/json-patch+json', 'application/jsonx') and ignores q-value exclusions. 1996's approach handles a strictly larger set of correct/incorrect cases while touching the same file/function.
